Disney and Pixar have officially confirmed that Toy Story 5 will begin streaming exclusively on Disney+ on September 23, 2026, following its hugely successful theatrical run.

The film has grossed more than $1.1 billion worldwide since its June release and will now join the rest of the Toy Story franchise on Disney’s streaming service.

A new trailer has also been released alongside the streaming announcement.
